description: Spec 019 (phase 7, SRD Annex C §C.14, decision 35): the frozen -g1 fused tracker against the frozen -g1 IMM, judged at G5 unchanged on fresh seed 218 (400,000; its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone) with realistic bearing error (generator 0.6.0, configs/phase7-ranges.json). Nothing is trained or re-tuned: the dataset (seed 211, phase-4 ranges) supplies the normalisation for T2's derived features, and the plan pins the fresh test digest and binds its header to the phase-7 ranges.
